title: Identity Directories: Setup and Docker Runs
description: Create isolated identity directories for researcher and writer agents with restrictive permissions, then run each in Docker with carefully scoped mounts and no network access.

steps.description: Complete terminal session for two-agent workspace setup.
Top-level directory: create agents directory under project root with mkdir -p.
Identity directories: create researcher and writer subdirectories {config,memory,logs,workspace} in one command.
Permissions: chmod 700 on identity directories prevents other users from reading memory and logs.
Shared knowledgebase: chmod 755 makes it readable by Docker agent running as different UID.
Shared output: chmod 750 allows owner and group to read/write, others cannot.
Researcher container: mounts identity dir rw, knowledgebase ro, network none, runs python agent.py.
Writer container: mounts its own identity dir, shared output rw, researcher workspace ro, network none.
